pages.text: A dopant soaks into silicon by diffusion: the depth grows as √(Dt), and the carriers it leaves set the conductivity. A junction needs 10¹⁶ to 10¹⁸ carriers per cm³; over-doped, the wafer conducts like a metal and the junction is gone.
$(thing)Set$(): Dopant dose (log₁₀ /cm²), Diffusion time.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Furnace drift: the diffusion varies by ±2%·d.
$(thing)Limits$(): none beyond the recipe windows.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): Shorter diffusion, more wafers.
